name: be.msdc.hypco.internal.ui.activity.MainActivity
description: This is part of MrSweeter's HypCo app logger. This is HypCo's app-logging screen; when opened, it loads the saved records and lets users export a selected item as a JSON file.
disableEffect: HypCo's saved-record browser and JSON export screen will be unavailable; the host app's features are unaffected.
